messages:
Maya: Quick presales thread for OceanRetail POC. They want: websocket SDK streaming, server-side function callbacks to their order webhook, structured JSON output (schema validation), and a two-week trial estimate. Can we outline requirements + any immediate blockers? @diego @samir
Diego: Short answer: yes. A few clarifying Qs: Do they need at-least-once semantics for webhook delivery or prefer exactly-once? Also what auth method for webhook?
Maya: They prefer exactly-once but will accept idempotent at-least-once if we provide dedupe guidance. Webhook will be behind their WAF and accepts HMAC signatures.
Samir: Perfect. Our recommended pattern: (1) send func_call envelope with call_id + idempotency_key, (2) webhook must ack 200 quickly, (3) if 5xx or timeout our retry policy triggers exponential backoff with jitter up to 5 attempts. Include Retry-After handling for 429. Example envelope below.
Eleni: Can we include a small JSON example here for their devs?
Samir: Yep. Example payload (single-line for slack): {"type":"func_call","id":"fc_01","name":"submit_order","payload":{"order_id":"OR-1001","items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":1}]},"trace":"tx-9"}
Diego: SDK notes: websocket client supports automatic `ack` calls; devs can override to forward ack after local enqueue. For 500 req/s baseline we recommend enabling client batching (batch_size=6) + server batching TTL 30ms to balance latency. Also enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to cut token usage.
Maya: Telemetry: they asked about trace propagation and logs. We should pass X-Trace-Id and X-Request-Id through the func_call. Also we can add per-call latency and token usage in the callback headers if they opt-in.
InfraBot: Test cluster provisioned: "presales-rt1" (6xA10G). Ingress qps limit 1200, burst 2k. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/presales-rt1
LegalBot: Heads-up: If webhook payload contains customer PII, Legal needs completed security questionnaire and SOC2 attestation. Also confirm retention period for webhook logs.
Maya: Pricing/estimate request: they asked for a ballpark for a 2-week POC at ~500 sustained req/s, avg 80 input tokens and 40 output tokens. Can finance give a rough hosted cost so we can present quickly? @eleni
Eleni: I'll do a quick calc and share a ballpark. For demos we can also offer trial credits; need approval for >$5k spend from Sales Ops.
Diego: Integration checklist for the client devs: 1) implement HMAC verification using our header signature (X-RW-Signature), 2) make webhooks idempotent by persisting order_id + call_id, 3) respond 200 quickly and process async, 4) respect Retry-After and 5xx retries. I'll paste a tiny JS snippet:
```js
const ws = new RedwoodWS({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
ws.on('func_call', async (msg) => {
  ws.ack(msg.id); // immediate ack
  await fetch(process.env.WEBHOOK_URL, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(msg.payload), headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
});
ws.connect();
```
Samir: Ops best-practices: enable idempotency window >= 24h for order flows, configure webhook retry policy conservative enough to not overload client systems, and add a dead-letter queue for failed deliveries so we can investigate.
Maya: Action items: Diego publish SDK sample + batching config, Samir publish webhook envelope + retry headers doc, Eleni draft ballpark pricing and trial credit ask, LegalBot send security questionnaire. Schedule kickoff Fri 9am PT. Any blockers?
LegalBot: Need to confirm SOC2 date and whether PII will be included. If they can't sign, propose anonymized payloads for demo.
Diego: Will push sample repo link pre-call.
Maya: Thanks team. Will record notes and invite Friday. :thumbsup:
